name: jacket
description: A short jacket with long sleeves, a center fastening and a broad lower band.
useCase: Identify jackets or short outerwear in a clothing catalogue.
misuse: Use a visible label when clothing identifies a product, size or dress requirement.

16.reason: The center fastening divides the broad lower band between two full sleeves.

24.reason: The larger jacket keeps both sleeves and the two lower band sections clear.
